name: Doctor Strange
summary: A surgeon who lost his hands and found the universe. Stephen Strange, Marvel's Sorcerer Supreme, guards Earth against magical threats from a townhouse on Bleecker Street.
origin: Doctor Strange started as Steve Ditko's idea, and you can see it in every trippy dimension he drew. He and Stan Lee introduced Stephen Strange in Strange Tales #110 in 1963, when Marvel wanted a different flavour of hero built on mysticism instead of muscle. The setup: a brilliant but arrogant surgeon wrecks his hands in a car crash, burns through his money hunting a cure, and ends up in the Himalayas with a mystic called the Ancient One. He goes home a sorcerer and eventually becomes Sorcerer Supreme, Earth's chief guardian against magical threats, working out of a Greenwich Village townhouse. Few heroes start from a more satisfying fall.
powers: Master of spells and the mystic arts
Mystic relics like the Cloak of Levitation and Eye of Agamotto

storyline.title: The arrogant surgeon
storyline.beat: Stephen Strange is a brilliant, arrogant neurosurgeon whose hands are wrecked in a car accident. Searching for a cure, he finds the Ancient One in the Himalayas and becomes a sorcerer.

storyline.title: Psychedelic realms
storyline.beat: Steve Ditko sends Strange through surreal other dimensions to fight the dread Dormammu and meet the cosmic being Eternity, art that won a big following on college campuses.

storyline.title: Non-team founder
storyline.beat: Strange forms the Defenders with the Hulk and Namor, a loose team of loners.

storyline.title: Taking the title
storyline.beat: Steve Englehart and Frank Brunner have the Ancient One die and pass the title of Sorcerer Supreme to Strange.

storyline.title: The Last Days of Magic
storyline.beat: Jason Aaron shows that every spell takes a physical toll on Strange, just as an enemy sets out to wipe magic from existence.

gossip.text: In the comics, the Eye of Agamotto holds an Infinity Stone.
gossip.truth: That is a film idea. In the comics the Eye is a mystical amulet with no Infinity Stone inside.

gossip.text: His home, the Sanctum Sanctorum, sits at 177A Bleecker Street in Greenwich Village.
Pink Floyd's 1968 album A Saucerful of Secrets slipped Doctor Strange artwork into its cover collage.
Stan Lee credited Steve Ditko with bringing him the idea for Doctor Strange.
He was a founding member of the Defenders, alongside the Hulk and Namor.

quiz.q: What is the Sanctum Sanctorum's address?
What was Stephen Strange's job before magic?
quiz.why: He was a top neurosurgeon until a car crash damaged his hands.

quiz.q: Who taught Strange the mystic arts?
quiz.why: The Ancient One trained him in the Himalayas.

quiz.q: Which team did he co-found in 1971?
quiz.why: He formed the Defenders with the Hulk and Namor.

theme.tagline: Bends reality, keeps the bedside manner.

timeline.title: A mystic in a backup slot
timeline.note: Strange Tales #110 introduces Steve Ditko's sorcerer in a five-page backup story, before his origin was even told.

timeline.title: Meeting Dormammu and Clea
timeline.note: Strange Tales #126 sends Strange into the Dark Dimension, where he first faces Dormammu and meets Clea.

timeline.title: Founding the Defenders
timeline.note: Marvel Feature #1 gathers Strange, the Hulk and the Sub-Mariner as the Defenders, Marvel's famous non-team.

timeline.title: Sorcerer Supreme
timeline.note: Marvel Premiere wraps a cosmic arc with the Ancient One's death, leaving Strange as Earth's top magician.

timeline.title: A TV movie pilot
timeline.note: Peter Hooten plays Strange in a CBS television movie meant to launch a series that never came.

timeline.title: Triumph and Torment
timeline.note: Strange and Doctor Doom team up for a trip into hell to rescue Doom's mother, in a hit graphic novel.

timeline.title: Benedict Cumberbatch casts in
timeline.note: Doctor Strange brings the character to the MCU with mind-bending visuals and a folding-city action finale.

timeline.title: The Death of Doctor Strange
timeline.note: A murder mystery event kills Stephen, and his wife Clea soon takes over as the new Sorcerer Supreme.
